review_cost.rationale: Approve with nits: all findings are localized, low-risk changes a reviewer would list in one pass rather than rework.

findings.issue: The 200ms search debounce timer is never cancelled when the component unmounts; typing then clicking a card within the window fires goto('/?q=…') after navigation and bounces the user back to the search results.
findings.suggestion: Clear the timer on destroy (e.g. an $effect returning () => clearTimeout(timer), or clear at the start of update/afterNavigate) so pending input can't navigate after unmount.

findings.issue: Local copy of load data kept in $state and resynced by writing state inside an $effect (same pattern at app/src/routes/team/+page.svelte:13); the official Svelte guidance says avoid updating state in effects, and the duplication risks divergence and future confusion.
findings.suggestion: Treat the cookie-backed server data as the single source of truth: mutate via saveTeam() then invalidate()/invalidateAll() (or a {#key} on the param), removing both effects.

findings.issue: Each-block key `${row.name}-${row.level}-${i}` includes the index, so every sort changes all keys and recreates the row DOM, defeating the purpose of a keyed each.
findings.suggestion: Key by `${row.name}-${row.level}` (already unique per method table given the method|move|level dedup in pokedex.ts:238-241) and drop the index.

findings.issue: Single module holds API response types, helpers and the loaders for all six pages; it will grow into the file everyone touches.
findings.suggestion: Split by resource (species/pokemon, moves, abilities, types, team) with a shared api.ts, keeping the server-only boundary.

findings.issue: mapLimit + Promise.all means one failing sub-fetch (a single move or version-group record) fails the whole Pokémon page with a 500.
findings.suggestion: Catch per-item failures and either omit the row or surface a partial-data notice rather than failing the page.

findings.issue: An unrecognized ?game= value silently selects the latest version group while the URL keeps the invalid parameter, so the URL and UI disagree.
findings.suggestion: Either 404/strip the invalid parameter or return the effective selection so the page can rewrite the URL.

findings.issue: Re-exports the shared Card/EvolutionNode/MoveRow/MoveTable/TypeRef types already exported from app/src/lib/types.ts, creating two import paths for the same shapes.
findings.suggestion: Import the shared types directly from #lib/types.ts in consumers and drop the re-export.

summary: A genuinely current, idiomatic SvelteKit 3 + Svelte 5 runes codebase: plugin-based config, #lib subpath imports, throwing error(), snippets, keyed eachs, server-only data module, and a cookie-backed team feature that integrates cleanly. The flaws are small and local — an uncancelled debounce timer, a state-in-$effect sync pattern used twice, an index-poisoned each key, and one oversized data module. I'd merge after a short round of nits.
